bead.title: Couple terminal reap to the emission frontier
bead.description: Implement TD-008 CL-6 for terminal retention: terminal records must not be reaped until both the retention window has elapsed and the durable emission cursor has advanced past the record's CommandPosition. Keep the off-commit-path emission model intact and add the frontier regression coverage needed to prove the terminal record survives until it is emitted.
bead.acceptance: Terminal record never lost to reap; frontier test proves reap_frontier = min(terminal_at + retention, emission_cursor_position); conformance stays green.
